head.meta_description: Corporate event catering ideas Dubai offices: drop-off lunches, live stations, canapés and plated galas, with dietary options and budgeting.
head.h1: Corporate Event Catering Ideas Dubai Offices — Real Prices and Timings

opening_paragraph: Corporate Event Catering Ideas Dubai by myCHEF — Corporate catering in Dubai from myCHEF is priced from AED 90 per head for a working lunch, and from AED 700 for a chef cooking on site. Strong corporate event catering ideas match the service style to the occasion , not to the budget you started with. Pick the right format and the rest of the event tends to fall into place around it.

replace_in_block.block_on_your_page: What makes corporate event catering ideas in Dubai work?
replace_in_block.new_heading: What makes corporate event catering ideas in Dubai work?
new_paragraphs: The format is the decision that matters. Dubai runs on business events, so a corporate calendar here fills fast with launches, conferences and client dinners that each want a different food answer: the Dubai Media Office reports Dubai World Trade Centre alone hosted 134 MICE events drawing 2.19 million participants in 2025, up 8 per cent on the year. Business event catering in Dubai covers everything from a boxed desk lunch to a plated gala, so start by naming the event's job: feed people quickly, get them mingling, or mark an occasion. A team stand-up needs food that eats in ten minutes at a desk. An awards night needs pacing, courses and staff. Once you know the job, the service style, headcount and budget follow in that order. Get those three wrong and no menu rescues the day. Corporate event catering in Dubai also means planning for a genuinely mixed room: colleagues who are fasting, guests who are vegetarian, and clients with allergies, all at the same table.

replace_in_block.block_on_your_page: Office catering ideas for team lunches and daily meetings
replace_in_block.new_heading: Office catering ideas for team lunches and daily meetings
new_paragraphs: For everyday office catering, keep it fast, tidy and generous. Drop-off platters, sandwich and salad boxes, and a compact working buffet suit daily meetings and a regular team lunch. A corporate buffet in Dubai works when people arrive in waves and serve themselves between sessions; individually boxed meals work better when the room is fasting-friendly or you want zero shared handling. For a recurring team lunch catering slot, rotate cuisines week to week so the same faces are not eating the same wrap every Wednesday. Label every tray with its contents and allergens, keep hot food genuinely hot, and leave clear vegetarian and vegan options instead of one sad afterthought. These are the office catering ideas that quietly keep a floor happy.

replace_in_block.block_on_your_page: Ideas for launches, activations and corporate parties
replace_in_block.new_heading: Ideas for launches, activations and corporate parties
new_paragraphs: For a launch or activation, feed movement instead of seating. The corporate party catering idea that lands in Dubai is a mix of passed canapes and interactive live stations, which feed movement, not seating, and keep guests circulating instead of queuing. Corporate canape catering suits a room where people hold a drink in one hand and a business card in the other. This is finger food catering in Dubai in the literal sense: nothing that needs a plate, a knife or a second hand, and nothing that takes more than two bites to finish before the next conversation starts. A live pasta, grill or bao station gives guests a reason to gather and a chef to talk to. For an evening office party catering setup, add a mocktail bar so non-drinkers are looked after. Chef Marco Rossi runs Italian and Mediterranean stations that read premium without slowing the room, which is the balance a launch needs.

replace_in_block.block_on_your_page: Client dinners, galas and company events
replace_in_block.new_heading: Client dinners, galas and company events
new_paragraphs: For client entertaining, plated service signals the occasion. A company event catering plan for an awards night or a board dinner leans on seated courses, waiting staff and light styling, so the food matches the reason people dressed up. This is where a smaller headcount earns a bigger spend per head. Chef Ahmed Al-Rashid handles fine-dining plated menus for these evenings, while chef Layla Hassan builds Arabic and halal-forward spreads for Ramadan majlis dinners and iftar receptions. Keep the courses paced so speeches land between them, and brief the staff on who sits where. A gala should feel considered; a team lunch can stay low-key. Matching the effort to the event is the whole point of good corporate catering in Dubai.

replace_in_block.block_on_your_page: Corporate catering menu ideas: what to put on the table
replace_in_block.new_heading: Corporate catering menu ideas: what to put on the table
new_paragraphs: Build the menu around the room, not around one cuisine. The corporate catering menu ideas that suit the widest crowd in Dubai mix a shared grazing element, a hot centrepiece and a clear set of dietary options. An Arabic mezze spread, a carved or grilled main, and a pasta station cover most tastes; add sushi or an Asian station for variety. For corporate event food ideas that suit a fasting team, plan dishes that hold well and reheat cleanly. Keep halal as the default, mark vegetarian and vegan dishes plainly, and offer gluten-free and nut-free choices when you confirm numbers. Matteo Moretti handles pastry and dessert tables when an event wants a sweet finish. Ask your caterer to send a tasting menu before you lock the final list.

replace_in_block.block_on_your_page: How much does corporate catering cost in Dubai?
replace_in_block.new_heading: How much does corporate catering cost in Dubai?
new_paragraphs: Corporate catering prices in Dubai scale with service style, not just headcount, and the gap between the two ends is wider than most budgets assume. A working lunch delivered to the office starts from AED 90 per head. A standard event buffet starts from AED 120, and a premium buffet, BBQ, live-station or canape spread from AED 150. Those are food-format prices: the food arrives ready to serve and your own team handles the room. A chef cooking and serving on site is a different product and starts at AED 700 per person, rising to around AED 950 for full plated service with front-of-house staff. Set packages are quoted as a total rather than per head, from AED 2,400 for a family-style spread up to AED 5,500 for a fully staffed occasion.

Minimums matter as much as the rate. Volume formats run from 10 guests and buffets from 20, with a minimum order value of AED 900. After that the number moves on staffing ratio, live cooking, rentals, venue access and how wide the dietary spread has to be. Ask any corporate catering company for an itemised quote with the 5% VAT shown separately, then cut the lines that do not earn their place.
Cheap corporate event catering ideas that still look considered

The cheap corporate event catering ideas that work in Dubai are not the cheapest menu, they are the cheapest format done properly. Drop-off is where the real saving sits: no service staff, no rentals, no on-site cooking, which is most of the distance between AED 90 a head and AED 700. From there, three moves protect a budget without announcing themselves. Put one hot centrepiece on the table and let salads, breads and mezze carry the volume around it, because vegetable and grain dishes cost a fraction of what protein costs. Fix the headcount and stop paying for the ten people who answered maybe. And run the event at lunchtime, which needs no bar, less styling and fewer staff hours than the same room at eight in the evening.

What should not be cut is the dietary provision and the labelling. A guest who finds nothing on the table they can eat is the detail everyone remembers afterwards, and planning for them costs almost nothing.

replace_in_block.block_on_your_page: Choosing a corporate catering company and getting logistics right
replace_in_block.new_heading: Choosing a corporate catering company and getting logistics right
new_paragraphs: Choose on reliability first, flair second. Dubai has a crowded field of catering companies and most of them can produce a good-looking menu; far fewer can produce it for 200 people at 12:30 on a Tuesday, in a building with one service lift and a security desk that wants names in advance. A corporate catering company in Dubai lives or dies on turning up on time, feeding the headcount you booked, and handling dietary needs without drama. Nail down three things early: final headcount, the timing of each service, and venue access for the crew and equipment. Ask how chefs are checked before you book. MyCHEF is implementing a chef standard covering identity checks, a practical cooking assessment, reference verification and review after events, and partner chefs are being onboarded against it as it is rolled out. If you cater on a regular basis, a retainer with a rolling menu usually pays for itself and saves a fresh brief every month. Confirm licensing and food-safety cover in writing: in Dubai, food businesses fall under Dubai Municipality's Food Safety Department and the UAE's Federal Law No. 10 of 2015 on Food Safety, per the UAE Government portal , so hygiene, temperature control and clear allergen information are licensed obligations a serious caterer meets as standard, not extras you have to chase.

What menu ideas work for a corporate event in Dubai?

Build around a mixed crowd: an Arabic mezze grazing spread, a live pasta or grill station, and a compact plated menu for seated dinners. Keep halal default, flag vegetarian and vegan dishes on the menu card, and label allergens on every tray.

Allow 48 to 72 hours for a drop-off or buffet, three to five days for live stations and multi-staff events, and 7 to 14 days for a large corporate function or gala.
